d: NymCard is a full-stack payments infrastructure company. Founded in 2018, we give banks and financial institutions one platform, nCore, to issue cards, move money, lend, settle, and manage financial crime as a single system, not separate vendors stitched together. nCore is AI-native and built on a real-time data core, so every product runs on one shared view of the customer.

If you want real ownership and room to move fast, this is the team for you.

We are hiring an Operational Risk Manager to support and strengthen our operational risk programme across card issuing, payment processing, and supporting operations. The role focuses on the day-to-day execution of operational risk activities, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, monitored, and remediated in a structured, evidence-based manner.

You will work closely with Product, Technology, Operations, Fraud, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to assess operational risks arising from business-as-usual activities, new products, and change initiatives. You will help maintain risk frameworks, run RCSAs, track incidents and losses, and produce clear management information to support senior management and committee oversight.

Success in this role means accurate and current risk records, timely incident analysis, practical remediation actions, and consistent readiness for internal reviews, audits, and regulatory interactions.
q: 5F to 10 years of experience in operational risk, internal control, or risk management within a fintech, payments, or regulated financial services environment.
Working knowledge of UAE regulatory expectations, particularly CBUAE guidelines, with the ability to operate in a regulated environment.
Understanding of core payments and card-issuing processes, including transaction processing, settlements, chargebacks, fraud operations, and reconciliations.
Hands-on experience supporting RCSAs, incident tracking, KRIs, and operational risk reporting.
Strong analytical and documentation skills, with attention to detail and a practical, risk-based mindset.
Ability to work collaboratively with business and technical teams and communicate risk issues clearly and proportionately.
Familiarity with recognized risk management concepts such as Basel principles and ISO 31000 is an advantage.
A balanced hybrid approach that supports in-office collaboration for workshops, reviews, and stakeholder engagement, alongside flexibility for focused individual work.
Exposure to end-to-end operational risk activities within a growing FinTech, with opportunities for learning, professional development, and progression based on performance and impact.
Hands-on experience working with clients, partners, and stakeholders across the UAE and wider MENA region in a live payments environment.
The opportunity to contribute directly to the safety, resilience, and scalability of a regulated card-issuing platform, with visible outcomes from your work.

d: Join a fast-paced vehicle testing team supporting innovative automotive and mapping technology operations across major markets in the Middle East.

The Project Coordinator – Vehicle Testing Operations will serve as the primary operational point of contact between the client, Drivers, and internal project management team. This role is responsible for coordinating daily testing activities, conducting driver orientations and operational training, managing route assignments, monitoring driving progress, and ensuring that all testing activities are executed according to client requirements and established operational procedures.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and confident in managing client relationships and field operations. This position requires strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and monitoring skills, with the ability to manage multiple Drivers and ensure smooth execution of daily vehicle testing activities.
Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client coordination and operational concerns.
Attend client meetings, project briefings, and operational updates.
Communicate project requirements, operational updates, and performance expectations to Drivers.
Address client inquiries, escalate operational concerns, and ensure timely resolution of issues.
Maintain strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
Conduct Driver onboarding, orientation, and operational training before deployment.
Ensure Drivers understand assigned routes, driving schedules, testing procedures, safety protocols, and reporting requirements.
Provide regular coaching and guidance to ensure compliance with client expectations.
Monitor Driver attendance, punctuality, performance, and adherence to assigned schedules.
Coordinate Driver deployment, shift schedules, replacements, and daily manpower requirements.
Prepare and distribute daily route assignments and driving schedules to Drivers.
Monitor Driver progress and route completion throughout assigned shifts.
Ensure Drivers strictly follow designated routes and testing instructions, with no unauthorized detours or deviations.
Track daily driving distance, driving hours, route coverage, and task completion.
Coordinate route adjustments and reassignment when operationally necessary and authorized.
Identify route execution issues, delays, and deviations, and implement appropriate corrective actions.
Ensure accurate recording and reporting of completed routes and assigned driving activities.
Oversee daily vehicle testing operations to ensure activities run smoothly and according to project timelines.
Coordinate with Drivers, clients, and relevant operational teams to address day-to-day requirements.
Monitor vehicle availability, deployment schedules, and operational readiness.
Ensure completion and submission of daily operational reports, route logs, attendance records, and other required documentation.
Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
Escalate incidents, safety concerns, vehicle issues, and other critical operational matters promptly.
Support project planning, resource allocation, and operational performance tracking.
Ensure Drivers comply with traffic regulations, company policies, client requirements, and established safety procedures.
Monitor compliance with assigned driving hours, rest periods, and operational schedules.
Ensure all Drivers complete required safety briefings and operational training.
Review daily reports and ensure accurate documentation of route completion, incidents, and irregularities.
Prepare and present regular operational updates and performance reports to the client and management.
Maintain confidentiality of client information, vehicle testing activities, and project-related data.

d: MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

You will be the operational owner for production health of our financial crime intelligence platform: data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and the FCI backend services (APIs, graph/network services and databases). You monitor, triage, diagnose and fix incidents, keep scheduled pipelines running, and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes, runbooks and monitoring. You work directly with fraud investigators, analysts and the customer's IT/operations teams.

Strong Python skills for ETL development and debugging (Pandas and/or Polars; reading stack traces and fixing data type, schema and null-handling issues)
Strong SQL skills (PostgreSQL and/or Oracle): complex queries, query plans, partitioned tables, running and validating migrations

Working experience with Docker and containers; basic Kubernetes/OpenShift operations (oc/kubectl: logs, describe, rollout, resource limits)
Structured incident handling: prioritisation, root-cause analysis, documentation
Strong client-facing and written/verbal communication skills; comfortable explaining technical issues to non-technical users
Experience with Apache Airflow or other workflow orchestration
Knowledge of backend system and basic API development; understanding of OpenTelemetry-style tracing and structured JSON logs
Experience with diagnosing memory or performance issues in Python services
Experience with Git and a code review/release workflow; ability to submit small, tested fixes

r: li
Monitor daily data pipeline runs (Python/Polars/Pandas scripts, Airflow DAGs, scheduled jobs); detect failures, delays and data-quality problems before users do.
li

Triage and resolve production incidents: read logs, reproduce with sample data, find root cause (schema/dtype drift, corrupt or empty files, upstream delays, memory pressure, SQL errors) and apply or propose a tested fix.
li

Support platform backend (FastAPI services, graph/network API, PostgreSQL, Oracle sources): investigate slow or failing API calls, 5xx errors, memory growth and pod restarts using application logs, request traces and container metrics.
li
Run, re-run and back-fill pipelines safely (full vs incremental loads, dry-run modes, catch-up of missed days) and verify the output.
li
Execute and validate database changes and migrations in UAT and production following the change process, with rollback steps.
li
Operate in containerized environments (OpenShift/Kubernetes, Docker): check pod health, resource limits, environment settings, rollouts and logs using CLI tools, within namespace-level access.
li
Own incident communication: clear status updates, impact assessment and post-incident summaries for business and technical audiences.
li
Write and maintain runbooks, known-error lists and operational checklists; automate repetitive checks and alerts.
li
Reduce alert noise and tune alerting; make sure manual re-runs do not trigger duplicate customer-facing alerts.
li
Work with data engineers and developers to hand over defects with reproducible evidence, and to validate fixes through UAT before release.
li
Support onboarding of new data sources and data requests where operations are involved.
li
Follow security and data-handling rules: least-privilege access, no sensitive data in tickets or logs, approved change windows.
